rat-1.name: The Drowned Rat
rat-1.description: A low, smoky burrow dug into the bank halfway down Caerwyn's river stairs, its door reached by three wet steps. Tonight it is packed with dockworkers, while blue firelight glints off the upturned skiff-hull bar and the drowned rat preserved in gin.

outside.name: The river stairs
outside.description: Wet, green steps descend from the quay to the landing and the Rat's door.

outside.name: The dark river
outside.description: The river slaps at the foot of the stairs.

rooms.name: The taproom
rooms.description: One long, low, smoky room beneath a ceiling crowded with eel traps and old oars.

rooms.name: The scullery
rooms.description: A cramped workroom tucked at the back of the burrow.

doors.name: The street door
doors.description: The low door opens onto the landing after three steps down.

doors.name: The scullery door
doors.description: A plain door at the back of the taproom.

things.name: A driftwood fire
things.description: It burns blue with salt.

things.name: The upturned skiff-hull bar
things.description: The bar is an upturned skiff hull.

things.name: A shelf
things.description: It stands behind the bar.

things.name: A great jar of gin
things.description: The original drowned rat floats in the gin.

things.name: The rules board
things.description: Nan's capitals list the seven house rules, signed by N. Quill and enforced by Manners.

things.name: The champion's chair
things.description: The Rat's only armchair, reserved for the river-stairs arm-wrestling champion.

things.name: A card table
things.description: Dilly Sparrow runs her game here by the fire.

things.name: The porters, lightermen and bargees
things.description: Paid off early for tomorrow's procession, they pack the room; many are big, and many have a bandaged hand, arm or head.

people.name: Dilly Sparrow
people.note: Runs her card game by the fire.

people.name: The biggest man in the room
people.note: Sits in the fireside corner with his back to the wall and his right hand hidden under the table.

heron-1.name: The Heron Warehouse
heron-1.description: A tall, tarred-timber warehouse at the last lamps of Caerwyn's wharves, half on the wharf and half on piles above the river. Grain dust hangs in the lantern light while sacks are secretly shifted between stamped piles.

outside.name: Downriver wharf
outside.description: The wharf ends in darkness where the lamps give out.

outside.name: Slippery plank walk
outside.description: A narrow walk on piles runs along the river door.

outside.name: Black river
outside.description: High, fast water runs beneath the warehouse as the tide turns.

outside.name: The Patience
outside.description: The broad, low Saltmere barge waits for the ebb, hatches open and bargees standing by.

rooms.name: Warehouse floor
rooms.description: One long, dust-thick floor between the land doors and the low river loading door.

doors.name: Land doors
doors.description: Big double doors in the wharf wall, with a wicket cut into one leaf.

doors.name: River loading door
doors.description: A low loading door at water level, with a grille; someone inside draws its bolt when shown the brass heron token.

things.name: a painted heron signboard
things.description: A heron is painted on the board above the land doors.

things.name: Saul's sentry box
things.description: A cramped box beside the entrance.

things.name: a brazier
things.description: Its coals glow in the last of the lamplight.

things.name: Duchess
things.description: The dog snores across the threshold.

things.name: the hoist beam
things.description: The beam swings sacks out over the river and down into the barge.

things.name: the palace grain sacks
things.description: Each sack bears the palace wheat-ear stamp.

things.name: the new heron-stamped sacks
things.description: Fresh sacks bearing the warehouse heron stamp.

things.name: a heap of empty wheat-ear sacks
things.description: Empty stamped sacks wait to be sent downriver.

things.name: a brazier for cold hands
things.description: Its heat is welcome; its flame is not supposed to be.

things.name: a NO NAKED LIGHTS sign
things.description: The painted warning is ignored by everyone.

things.name: lanterns
things.description: Their beams make the drifting grain dust look like fog.

things.name: the glass-sided counting-box
things.description: A glass-sided box hangs above the warehouse floor.

things.name: a short stair
things.description: It climbs to the counting-box.

things.name: the true book
things.description: The accounts lie open in the counting-box.

things.name: a brass heron token
things.description: The gang hold it up to the grille when they need the river door unbolted.

things.name: a sack chute
things.description: It runs down through the river door to the barge.

people.name: Saul
people.note: The sentry keeps watch beside the land doors.

people.name: Hep Grist's gang
people.note: They slit, pour and sew between the two stamped piles.

people.name: Mister Scrope
people.note: He sits under a lamp in the glass-sided box, keeping the true book open.

people.name: the Patience's bargees
people.note: They wait for the ebb before casting off.

chandler-1.name: The Wick & Knot
chandler-1.description: A cramped chandler's shop on the wharves, where coils of rope compete for space with jars of lamp oil. The air smells of tar, salt, and a wick that has been smoking since last week.

outside.name: The wharf
outside.description: A damp, busy stretch of timber wharf with rope scraps caught between the boards.

outside.name: The harbour
outside.description: Dark harbour water laps against the piles beneath the wharf.

rooms.name: Shop floor
rooms.description: The crowded main shop, with just enough clear floor for a customer to turn around if they do so carefully.

rooms.name: Stockroom
rooms.description: A cramped back room stacked with rope, spare wicks, and oil jars.

doors.name: Front door
doors.description: A narrow door swollen by damp and marked with a faded lamp sign.

doors.name: Stockroom door
doors.description: A low wooden door with a rope loop for a handle.

things.name: a scarred sales counter
things.description: Its surface is sticky with oil and covered in old knife marks.

things.name: a heap of rope coils
things.description: The heap has developed the shape of something that might be sleeping.

things.name: two lamp-oil barrels
things.description: A handwritten notice says, 'No smoking, especially you.'

things.name: a lit oil lantern
things.description: It gives off a brave little flame.

things.name: shelves of lamp wicks
things.description: The wicks are sorted by length, then by a system no one remembers.

things.name: a crate of oil jars
things.description: Several jars clink ominously when the floorboards flex.

things.name: a suspiciously knotted rope
things.description: Nobody admits to tying it into a knot that large.

things.name: a stack of bundled rope
things.description: Each bundle is labelled with a different kind of knot.

things.name: a row of sealed oil casks
a short ladder
things.description: It leads to a shelf that is not quite as sturdy as it looks.

chapel-1.name: The Little Chapel
chapel-1.description: A modest stone chapel tucked beside the market square, quiet except when the market's shouting finds its way inside. Its saint's statue is conspicuously missing one hand.

outside.name: Market square
outside.description: A busy cobbled square, full of stalls and people haggling.

rooms.name: Sanctuary
rooms.description: A simple worship space with worn flagstones and a small altar.

rooms.name: Vestry
rooms.description: A cramped side room for vestments and chapel odds and ends.

doors.name: Chapel door
doors.description: A plain wooden door between the square and the sanctuary.

doors.name: Vestry door
doors.description: A narrow door in the sanctuary's east side.

things.name: the handless saint's statue
things.description: The saint raises one arm; the other ends in a rough, empty wrist.

things.name: a stone altar
things.description: A squat altar, polished smooth by years of elbows.

things.name: a pair of candles
things.description: Two candles gutter whenever the market door opens.

things.name: an offering bowl
things.description: The bowl has collected more buttons than coins.

things.name: a tarnished plaque
things.description: The saint's name is almost worn away.

things.name: a bell rope
things.description: The rope disappears through a hole in the ceiling.

tannery-1.name: The Riverbank Tannery
tannery-1.description: A damp, smoke-dark tannery crouches beside the river, its workroom reeking of old hides and stronger chemicals. In the muddy yard, foul pits bubble beneath hides stretched tight on frames.

outside.name: The river
outside.description: A sluggish river laps at the bank, carrying the tannery's unmistakable smell downstream.

outside.name: The tannery yard
outside.description: A churned dirt yard holds stinking tanning pits and rows of hides stretched on frames.

rooms.name: Workroom
rooms.description: The broad, clammy workroom is stained dark by years of tannin and river mud.

rooms.name: Hide store
rooms.description: A cramped store for prepared hides, tools, and things best not examined too closely.

doors.name: Yard door
doors.description: A wide, warped door stands open to the yard.

doors.name: Store door
doors.description: A sturdy door joins the store to the workroom.

things.name: a tanning vat
things.description: A deep vat of brown tanning liquor gives off a truly heroic stink.

things.name: a scraping beam
things.description: A hide is stretched over the beam, awaiting the scraper.

things.name: a rack of tanning tools
things.description: Knives and hooks hang from the rack, all looking sharp enough.

things.name: a smoky lantern
things.description: Its smoky flame does little to improve the air.

things.name: a row of tanning pits
things.description: Several pits brim with bubbling, foul-smelling tanning solution.

things.name: frames of stretched hides
things.description: Hides are pulled tight across a line of creaking frames.

things.name: a stack of cured hides
things.description: The stack is neatly tied, though the smell is not.

watch-1.name: The North Gate Watch House
watch-1.description: A squat, practical watch house beside the north gate, with a front office for complaints and two barred cells at the back. The pike rack suggests the watch expects arguments to become more physical.

outside.name: Gate street
outside.description: A narrow cobbled street leading to the north gate.

rooms.name: Front office
rooms.description: The watch's workroom and public reception, occupying the front and most of the building.

rooms.name: West cell
rooms.description: A bare stone cell with a barred door.

rooms.name: East cell
rooms.description: A second bare stone cell, equally unwelcoming.

doors.name: Street door
doors.description: A stout door opening onto the gate street.

doors.name: West cell door
doors.description: A barred door between the office and the west cell.

doors.name: East cell door
doors.description: A barred door between the office and the east cell.

things.name: a scarred watch desk
things.description: Its surface is crowded with old ink stains.

things.name: a rack of pikes
things.description: The pikes are kept point-up, for everyone's convenience except the tall.

things.name: a complaint ledger
things.description: Several pages bear the words 'about the pikes'.

things.name: a three-legged stool
things.description: One leg is shorter than the others.

bathhouse-1.name: The Salted Soap
bathhouse-1.description: A steamy public bathhouse run by a retired pirate who insists that all towels are properly swabbed. The hot room fogs up the windows, and the cold plunge is said to cure anything except scurvy and bad manners.

outside.name: Soap Street
outside.description: A narrow cobbled street, usually slick with water tracked out by bathers.

rooms.name: Bathing Hall
rooms.description: The main bathing hall, warm and echoing, with benches for resting between baths.

rooms.name: Changing Room
rooms.description: A snug room of numbered pegs, damp clothes, and suspiciously many boots.

rooms.name: Hot Room
rooms.description: A close, steamy room where stones hiss and the air smells faintly of boiled seaweed.

rooms.name: Cold Plunge Room
rooms.description: A chilly tiled room dominated by a plunge pool that makes even the bravest pirate yelp.

doors.name: Street Door
doors.description: A stout door with a sign warning that cutlasses must be checked at the desk.

doors.name: Changing Room Door
doors.description: A wooden door with a peg-shaped handle.

doors.name: Hot Room Door
doors.description: A thick door that keeps most of the steam in.

doors.name: Plunge Room Door
doors.description: A damp door with a hand-painted sign reading BRACE YOURSELF.

things.name: the reception counter
things.description: A scarred counter where bathers pay and surrender sharp objects.

things.name: a bathhouse sign
things.description: A painted anchor floats cheerfully among bubbles.

things.name: a laundry basket
things.description: It is already overflowing with towels.

things.name: the stone steam hearth
things.description: Hot stones hiss beneath a little iron kettle.

things.name: the cold plunge pool
things.description: The water is startlingly cold and suspiciously clear.

things.name: stone steps
things.description: The steps descend into the plunge pool.

people.name: Captain Mara Vane
people.note: The retired pirate proprietor wears a bathrobe over her old captain's coat and keeps a cutlass behind the counter.

stables-1.name: The Coaching Inn Stable Yard
stables-1.description: A close, muddy yard behind the coaching inn, with the stable opening onto it and stalls running along one side. A coach with a broken wheel is left where it can inconvenience everyone equally.

outside.name: Stable yard
outside.description: A muddy, enclosed yard behind the inn, with room for a coach to turn if the coach is willing.

rooms.name: Stable
rooms.description: The main stable space, dim and earthy, with a ladder up to the hayloft.

rooms.name: Stall side
rooms.description: A row of stalls occupies this side of the stable, separated by sturdy partitions.

doors.name: Stable yard door
doors.description: A broad pair of doors opening onto the yard.

doors.name: Stall passage
doors.description: A wide opening between the stable and the stall side.

things.name: the stall partitions
things.description: Four sturdy partitions divide the stalls.

things.name: a hayloft ladder
things.description: A steep ladder climbs through a hatch to the hayloft.

things.name: a water trough
things.description: The trough is full of water and suspiciously clean at one end.

things.name: a coach with a broken wheel
things.description: The coach is parked at an angle, its wheel broken and its usefulness debatable.

things.name: the broken wheel
things.description: The detached wheel leans against the coach.

things.name: a stack of hay bales
things.description: A few bales are stacked just inside the stable doors.

things.name: a lantern
things.description: A sooty lantern hangs over the stable passage.

bakery-1.name: The Floury Loaf
bakery-1.description: A cramped baker’s shop where flour coats every surface and the ovens glow at the back. A cat sleeps on the warm bread shelf, apparently in charge of quality control.

outside.name: Baker’s Street
outside.description: A narrow cobbled street runs past the shopfront.

rooms.name: Shop floor
rooms.description: The customer-facing shop, with a counter and flour tracked across the tiled floor.

rooms.name: Bake room
rooms.description: The hot workroom at the back, dominated by ovens and a shelf for cooling bread.

doors.name: Shop door
doors.description: A sturdy door with a little bell above it.

doors.name: Bake-room door
doors.description: A swinging door between the shop and the hot bake room.

things.name: the shop counter
things.description: A flour-dusted counter separates customers from the loaves.

things.name: a painted loaf sign
things.description: The sign depicts a loaf with an unexpectedly stern expression.

things.name: a flour sack
things.description: Flour puffs out around its open mouth.

things.name: another flour sack
things.description: A lumpy sack with a handprint in flour on its side.

things.name: the brick oven
things.description: The oven radiates a heat that reaches the shop through the open door.

things.name: the warm bread shelf
things.description: A broad shelf holds cooling loaves above the warm tiled floor.

things.name: a cooling rack
things.description: A rack crowded with fresh loaves stands near the ovens.

things.name: a flour-dusted worktable
things.description: The table is buried beneath a fine drift of flour.

things.name: a wooden oven peel
things.description: A long-handled peel leans within easy reach of the oven.

things.name: a cat
things.description: The cat snores softly on the warm shelf, nestled between two loaves.
